name: Caillou
description: Follow Caillou, the lovable 4-year-old with a big imagination, as he and his friends go on adventures and experience all the wonders of being a child.

credits_cast.character: Léo / André / Miss Martin / Jonathan / Sébastien (voice)
credits_cast.name: Johanne Garneau

Caillou Makes Cookies
videos.overview: Caillou is having fun being noisy, but his Mommy asks him to be quiet. All of a sudden he feels hungry, so he goes off to the kitchen -- where he gets the idea to make some cookies. Only instead of making cookies, he makes a great big gooey, sweet and delicious mess!

videos.title: Caillou's Not Afraid Anymore
videos.overview: Caillou is afraid. He’s afraid of Mr. Hinkle, the kind man who lives next door. He is even afraid of Mr. Hinkle’s house! So when Mr. Hinkle comes to visit to say how sorry he is that Caillou is afraid, Caillou runs away. But it quickly turns into a game of hide and seek and when playtime is over Caillou has made a new friend.

videos.title: Caillou Hates Vegetables
videos.overview: Caillou really hates vegetables until he goes for a walk in the park with his Grandpa, who shows him all kinds of interesting animals and birds. All this activity makes them hungry—as hungry as bears! So when it’s suppertime, they eat just like bears, pretending their vegetables are berries, (leaving just enough room for cookies, of course).

videos.title: Caillou's All Alone
videos.overview: Mom is very busy with the household accounts so she doesn’t have time to play with Caillou. Nor does Dad, who’s trying to fix the washing machine. And Grandma’s busy looking after Rosie. Even Gilbert the cat doesn’t want to play with him. Caillou is all alone and feeling a bit sorry for himself. But pretty soon he invents a game with one of his dinosaurs and then he’s too busy to play with everyone else.

videos.title: Caillou Tidies His Toys
videos.overview: Caillou has left his toys all over the place: on the stairs, in the driveway and even in the bathroom. He has to tidy them all before he can have his chocolate pudding. Part of the problem is that he has so many toys. Mom suggests that he should give some of his old ones to Rosie and Dad suggests that he can make a big toy box. Caillou helps him to make it.

videos.title: Caillou Learns to Drive
videos.overview: Just like his Daddy, Caillou loves anything to do with cars, so he’s very happy when Dad asks him to help wash the family car. And while he sits in the car, he imagines he’s driving a car to the beach. When he beeps the horn, he surprises Dad, making him accidentally turn the hose on himself. Later on, when the family really goes for a drive to the beach, Caillou is reminded of his imaginary journey.

videos.title: Caillou at Daycare
videos.overview: It’s Caillou’s first day at day care and he really doesn’t want to go. But once he gets there he meets his teacher, Miss Martin and makes two new friends, Leo and Clementine. Day care is a fun place, after all and when his Mommy comes to pick him up, Caillou doesn’t want to go home!

videos.title: Caillou Joins the Circus
videos.overview: Caillou gets up very early one morning and gets dressed all by himself. He doesn’t want to miss a trip to the circus. So when Dad points out that the circus trip is the following day, Caillou is very disappointed. In fact he’s not in a good mood at all. But Dad makes everything right by suggesting a special game: together, they create their own circus parade.

videos.title: Caillou is Afraid in the Dark
videos.overview: Caillou can’t get to sleep because he’s sure there’s a monster in his bedroom. Mom and Dad try to reassure him, but things go from bad to worse when he thinks his toy snake is real. Dad shows him that the scary noises he hears are being made by a tree branch brushing against the window and in the end, the only ‘monster’ in Caillou’s room is Gilbert the cat.

videos.title: Caillou's Friends
videos.overview: Caillou is talking to Grandma. She's surprised when he tells her he doesn't have any friends. She asks him about Clementine and Leo and reminds him that Gilbert is a friend too. And what about Rosie? Well yes, says Caillou, Rosie is my sister, but she's my friend too. And how about Mr. Hinkle? And Mom and Dad? Pretty soon, Caillou realizes he has lots of friends including Grandma.

videos.title: Caillou Visits the Doctor
videos.overview: Caillou needs a follow-up visit to the doctor for an earache. He is afraid to go in as the last visit frightened him. But his mother encourages him and the doctor assures him it won't hurt this time. Caillou examines a doll's ear first and thinks it's fun. Then the doctor looks in his. He's on the mend and onto a good thing. When he gets home he shines a flashlight in everyone's ear including Grandma who's snoozing in the armchair!

videos.title: Big Brother Caillou
videos.overview: Caillou remembers when he was just two and a half and Rosie came home for the first time. Everybody was very excited—everybody except Caillou, who felt a bit left out. But that soon changed, especially when Caillou helped Daddy change Rosie’s diaper.

videos.title: Caillou Goes Shopping
videos.overview: It’s a busy day. First of all it’s snowing and Caillou is looking forward to making a snowman. And Mom’s making one of her special surprise cakes, which means Caillou and Rosie have to go to the shop with her to get the ingredients. And then Caillou gets lost in the shop…but it all works out fine in the end. And the snowman is delicious!

videos.title: Caillou in the Bathtub
videos.overview: It’s bath time. And for Caillou that means trouble. He just doesn’t like taking baths. But bit by bit bath time turns into playtime, thanks to Daddy, a motorboat and a big bottle of bubble bath.

videos.title: Caillou Gets Dressed
videos.overview: Mom’s doing the laundry and Caillou decides to get dressed all by himself. The problem is, he doesn’t have any clean clothes to wear. So Daddy suggests a dressing-up game with some of his old clothes. Pretty soon Caillou is not only all dressed up he even has a moustache to go with his fancy outfit.

videos.title: Caillou's Teddy Shirt
videos.overview: Caillou's favorite shirt has teddy bears all over it. It's his teddy shirt. One day he sees Rosie wearing it and he gets very upset. But he has to admit that he's getting too big for the teddy shirt. In fact, he can hardly get into it. But he doesn't really want Rosie to have it, so he gives it to his favorite teddy bear to wear.

videos.title: Caillou Goes Round the Block
videos.overview: Caillou has lots of big adventures when he goes round the block by himself for the first time. He meets Sarah out on her skateboard; he sees a rainbow; he plays hopscotch and he meets a scary crow. By the time he gets home he’s really happy to see Mom again.

videos.title: Caillou's Hiding Place
videos.overview: Caillou is at Grandpa and Grandma's house. He goes looking for a special hiding place and gets stuck in a kitchen closet. Grandpa shows Caillou an extra-special place: a hollow tree trunk. Caillou discovers an old toy in the hiding place and learns that it used to be his Daddy's hiding place when he was Caillou's age.

videos.title: Caillou's Birthday Present
videos.overview: It’s Caillou’s birthday and he’s having a little party. His friends Clementine and Leo come to play with him and they all have face paint disguises. What Caillou really wants for his birthday is a special dinosaur. And by the time the party’s over he unexpectedly has two of them!

videos.title: Caillou and Gilbert
videos.overview: Caillou has nobody to play with, so he recruits Gilbert his cat. He tries to get Gilbert to play his favorite games, but Gilbert isn’t interested in the slightest. When Mom points out that Caillou’s been trying to get the cat to play people games, he realizes that Gilbert probably wants to play kitty cat games. That works much better!

videos.title: Caillou's Summer Goodnight
videos.overview: Caillou is tossing and turning. No matter what he does he just can’t get to sleep. It’s summer and his curtains are at the cleaners. Luckily Grandma has a wonderful idea: She makes a cardboard cutout night sky to put against the window. It darkens the room and projects the moon and the stars onto his walls and ceiling. Caillou falls asleep in no time.

videos.title: Caillou is Scared of Dogs
videos.overview: One day in the park Caillou is scared by a stranger’s dog, so he’s very nervous when he visits Grandma’s house and discovers she’s looking after a friend’s dog. But bit by bit they get to know each other and pretty soon Caillou isn’t nervous at all. In fact he’s made a brand new friend.

videos.title: Caillou Goes to the Zoo
videos.overview: Caillou and his family go to the zoo. Caillou is thrilled to see that animals have families too. He sees a baby rhino and a big family of chimpanzees. But his absolute favorite is a young sea otter, which has to be taught how to swim.

videos.title: Caillou's Rainy Day
videos.overview: It’s a rainy day and Caillou is looking forward to jumping in all the puddles when he goes out with his Mommy. But somehow or other it takes Caillou a very long time to get ready to go out. There’s always something else he has to do before he can leave. So by the time he does leave, it has stopped raining. Happily, there are still some puddles to splash in.

videos.title: Caillou at the Beach
videos.overview: Caillou and his family are spending the day at the beach. There’s so much to see and do! Caillou and Dad go into the water; a seagull tries to steal Caillou’s sandwich; Caillou sees a hermit crab and finally he and Dad build a sandcastle.

videos.title: Caillou's New Shoes
videos.overview: Caillou goes with Mom to buy a new pair of shoes. On the way he sees Sarah running fast. He decides he wants a pair of shoes he can run in. First, the salesman has to measure his feet. Eventually he picks exactly the right pair and he shows Sarah just how fast he can run.

videos.title: Caillou's Snowman
videos.overview: Caillou wants to make a snowman, but he doesn’t really know how. Luckily, Sarah knows how to make snowmen very well and they work together building the components and putting them together. When they’re finished, Mom provides the finishing touches: A carrot for his nose and some big buttons for his eyes and his smile.

videos.title: Caillou is a Clown
videos.overview: Caillou is very excited because he’s going to a parade with horses, drummers and clowns. But Rosie is afraid of clowns so Mom isn’t sure it’s a good idea to go. Caillou is upset because he thinks he’ll miss the parade just because of that. And then he has a good idea: If he shows Rosie that clowns are just people wearing silly costumes, she won’t be afraid anymore.

videos.title: Caillou's Special Friend
videos.overview: Caillou is having fun with his friend—his special friend—George. What makes George so special? Well, he’s invisible for one thing... George and Caillou have a race and break a flowerpot. At first Caillou blames George, but his Daddy talks to him and he agrees that he might have had a little something to do with it too.

videos.title: Caillou Rakes the Leaves
videos.overview: It’s fall and the backyard is covered with leaves. Caillou and Rosie have so much fun playing in the leaves that Caillou doesn’t want to go into the house. He asks Dad if he can help him rake the leaves into piles. When they’ve made piles of piles, Caillou pretends the piles of leaves are houses enough houses to make a city.

videos.title: Caillou's Big Friend
videos.overview: Caillou meets a new friend called André and André is big! Caillou never had a friend this big before. André is also a bit clumsy, so playing with him means things tend to get broken. Caillou is particularly upset when André breaks his favorite chair, but all is soon forgotten when they go outside and play soccer.

videos.title: Caillou's Colours
videos.overview: Caillou is visiting Grandma’s house and he’s not in a very good mood. While Grandma goes into the kitchen, Caillou starts to make a finger painting with Grandma’s blue paint and pretty soon he’s using all of Grandma’s colors and feeling much, much better.

videos.title: Caillou Mails a Letter
videos.overview: Mom is upset when the mailman only brings bills, bills and more bills. She tells Caillou she'd love to get a nice letter for a change. Caillou and Dad decide to make a nice letter for her and early the next morning they give it to the mailman to deliver. Mom is thrilled to get such a nice letter from Caillou.

videos.title: Caillou Goes Camping
videos.overview: Grandpa tells Caillou about the time when his Daddy was a little boy and they went on a camping trip. Caillou loves the idea of camping and he and Grandpa set up the tent in the garden. Caillou is excited to see the stars in the sky and the fireflies in the bushes. But once they settle in to go to sleep, Caillou gets a bit nervous, so Grandpa comes up with a surprise solution!

videos.title: Caillou Learns to Swim
videos.overview: Caillou goes to the swimming pool with his family and Daddy teaches him how to swim. After a few lessons he’s getting better and better. Pretty soon, he wants to swim by himself and although it starts off with a bit of a scare, everything ends up just fine. Caillou can swim now.

videos.title: Caillou's New Babysitter
videos.overview: Mom and Dad are going out. Caillou wants his regular baby-sitter, not Julie, whom he has never met before. He’s sure he isn’t going to like her. He gives Julie a hard time, refusing to eat his supper... But then Julie turns suppertime into a game and serves breakfast instead. Long before Mom and Dad come home, Caillou has decided he likes his new baby-sitter after all.

videos.title: Caillou Learns to Skate
videos.overview: Caillou has a hard time staying upright on his skates. He wants to be the fastest skater in the world but he keeps falling on the ice. Dad gives him a chair to hold onto to help his balance and after a little while and a lot of encouragement from Mom and Dad he is finally able to skate.

videos.title: Caillou Makes a New Friend
videos.overview: When Caillou first meets Jim in the sandbox at the park he doesn’t really like him at all. Jim grabs at everything he wants and Caillou is a bit intimidated. But Jim’s Mom and Caillou's Grandpa sort things out and the two boys discover how much fun they can have playing together.

videos.title: Caillou and Daddy
videos.overview: Mom and Rosie are out for the day and that means Caillou and Dad will spend the day together "taking care of business." Caillou likes having Dad all to himself and the two of them make a bookshelf for Mom and go out for a bike ride together, the way Caillou likes it: just the two of them, Caillou and Dad.

videos.title: Caillou Grows Carrots
videos.overview: When Grandpa comes over to help Mom make a vegetable garden he shows Caillou how to plant a bed of carrots. Caillou doesn’t like vegetables very much, but he’s very interested in seeing the results of his gardening. And when the carrots finally do come out of the ground he discovers they taste better than any vegetables he’s ever eaten.

videos.title: Caillou Goes to a Theme Park
videos.overview: Caillou and his family have a wonderful day out at a theme park. Caillou and Dad go on the thrilling Niagara River Ride, they all go on a Ferris wheel and for a special treat they have cotton candy for dessert. The perfect day is made even better when Dad tosses rings at a midway booth and wins the biggest teddy bear Caillou has ever seen.

videos.title: Caillou's School Bus
videos.overview: Caillou doesn’t go to school yet but he really wants to ride on the school bus that stops outside his house every morning. When Dad takes him to see the bus from close up the driver offers to take Caillou with the other children the next day. Caillou makes a special painting for the driver and they have a marvellous ride.

videos.title: Caillou Looks for Gilbert
videos.overview: Caillou is having a game of dinosaur hunter with Gilbert the cat. He goes for a snack and when he comes back there’s no sign of Gilbert. He’s disappeared! Mom says Caillou will have to be a detective and together they search the house, looking for clues. Eventually they find Gilbert curled up and fast asleep in Caillou’s bed.

videos.title: Caillou's Surprise Breakfast
videos.overview: Caillou gets up early one morning. So early in fact that he’s the first person awake in the whole house. He decides to make his own breakfast—and then gets the idea to make Mom and Dad a surprise breakfast. It’s a lot of hard work and he does make a bit of a mess, but Caillou’s surprise breakfast is a big success.

videos.title: Caillou's Missing Sock
videos.overview: Caillou wants to wear his favorite socks, but one of them is missing. When he goes looking in the basement he accidentally gets himself locked in. Daddy to the rescue! Only now they're both locked in! Caillou and Dad shout to attract Mom's attention. She comes and lets them out and finds the missing sock.

videos.title: Caillou Goes to Work
videos.overview: Caillou is very excited when he goes to work with Mom. She works in a big building with revolving doors and elevators. While she works in her office Caillou does a nice drawing. They have lunch together and then Daddy comes to fetch Caillou. On the way out Caillou shows him how to work the elevators and the revolving doors.

videos.title: Caillou's Quarrel
videos.overview: Caillou’s bossy friend Clementine comes over to play. Caillou wants to play dinosaurs but Clementine insists on playing families. When she picks up his teddy bear he’s particularly upset, because it’s his teddy bear. They quarrel and it ends in tears. Mom sorts things out and they end up friends again, just in time to play baseball with Clementine’s brother Billy.

videos.title: Caillou's Getting Older!
videos.overview: Caillou is very curious when he finds a dead bird in the garden. He wants to know why it died. Dad explains that it probably got too old. Caillou thinks about that and begins to worry about getting too old himself. He tells Mom and Dad he doesn’t want to get any older because of what happened to the bird. They reassure him and he agrees he has plenty of time to get older.

videos.title: Caillou's Big Slide
videos.overview: Caillou is playing in the park with Clementine. She’s a lot more confident about most things than he is and she isn’t at all scared to go on the big kids’ slide. Caillou is frightened, but he can’t bring himself to admit it to Clementine. She teases him anyway. When Dad comes to fetch Caillou they go down the slide together. Caillou discovers it isn’t so hard after all and does it all by himself.

videos.title: Caillou Walks a Dog
videos.overview: Grandma is looking after her friend’s dog again. She shows Caillou how to walk the puppy on a leash and how to play ‘fetch’ with a ball. Caillou loves having the puppy obey his orders and pesters Mom and Dad for a dog of his own. They say he already has a pet: Gilbert. Maybe when he’s a bit older he can have a dog. Caillou understands and in the meantime he attached a leash to a toy dog and proudly walks it around the house.

videos.title: Caillou Watches Rosie
videos.overview: Mommy isn’t feeling well so she asks Caillou to watch Rosie and play quietly while she lies down for a while. They draw animals, but Rosie is naughty and starts drawing on the walls. When Mom comes in to see what all the fuss is about she is angry with poor Caillou—who thinks it’s unfair. Mom softens and together they clean up Rosie’s mess.

videos.title: Caillou Is Sick
videos.overview: Caillou has a fever. Then he gets itchy spots. Chicken pox! He’s not very comfortable and he has to take special baths to soothe the itching. He knows he’s not supposed to scratch but he just can’t help himself. When he sees Rosie playing in the garden he wants to play with her and can’t wait to get better. But by the time he’s finally well enough to go out and pay, it turns out Rosie has chicken pox too!

videos.title: Caillou's Phone Call
videos.overview: When Mom is busy on the phone all morning and doesn’t have time for Caillou he feels very left out of things. He plays with his toy phone and then talks to Grandma on the real phone. He likes talking on the phone -- it makes him feel very grown up.

videos.title: Caillou Sleeps Over
videos.overview: Caillou is going to spend the night away from his home and family for the very first time. He goes to Leo's house and has a lot of fun in Leo's tree house, but at bedtime he's feeling lonely and homesick. Leo's mom suggests he should phone home. He feels much better when he speaks to his Mommy and even better when she reminds him he has his teddy bear with him.

videos.title: Caillou Plays Baby
videos.overview: Caillou thinks his sister Rosie is getting favorable treatment and it just isn’t fair! Mom explains to him that Rosie is just a baby and can’t do a lot of the things she asks him to do. Caillou decides being a baby is better than being four and pretends to be a baby—until Mom tells both her babies it’s time for a nap. Maybe being four is better than being a baby after all!

videos.title: Caillou Flies on a Plane
videos.overview: It’s Caillou’s first flight and he’s curious about everything. He loves looking out of the window at the ground below; he likes playing with the music system; breakfast on a plane is an adventure in itself and when the pilot invites him to visit the flight deck with Daddy that’s the best of all!

videos.title: Rosie Bothers Caillou
videos.overview: It’s not always easy being a big brother. Caillou likes Rosie very much, but she can really be a big nuisance. She’s bothering Caillou, interrupting him when all he wants to do is read his book. He sends her away, but pretty soon he wants to play a game and it’s always better to play with somebody else.

videos.title: Caillou Goes Birdwatching
videos.overview: Grandma always has the best surprises for Caillou. When they go to the park together she introduces him to the birds that live there. The chickadees and cardinals come and take the food right out of his hand. When they go home Grandma presents Caillou with a little birdhouse so he can go bird-watching every day.

videos.title: Caillou and the Doll
videos.overview: Mom is putting on her makeup to go out with Dad and that gives Caillou an idea for a game. He takes one of Rosie’s dolls and tries to make it look as pretty as his Mom—with disastrous results. He’s ashamed, so he hides the doll. At first he tries to pretend he doesn’t know where it is, but he quickly admits the truth and all is well again.

videos.title: Caillou Hurts Himself
videos.overview: Poor Caillou! He’s fallen off his bike and scraped his knee. The mishap has hurt his knee and his pride too. He needs the special touch of Mom’s first-aid. When she puts a special plaster on Caillou, the one with the dinosaur pattern, he begins to feel much better.

videos.title: Caillou's Big Kick
videos.overview: Caillou’s big friend André has come to visit. André is a soccer player and Caillou wants to play too... Only Caillou isn’t very good at kicking the ball. Sometimes he misses altogether sometimes it only goes a few inches. He wants to give up, but André and Dad encourage him and eventually he makes the biggest kick of the day.

videos.title: Caillou the Jungle Explorer
videos.overview: Caillou’s friend Sarah has a magnifying glass. She shows Caillou how it makes everything in the garden look bigger and suggests a game: Caillou will be a great jungle explorer, using the magnifying glass to make butterflies look as big as birds and Gilbert the cat as big as a lion.

videos.title: The Caillou Show
videos.overview: There’s a special event at Caillou’s daycare. Leo, Clementine and Caillou are getting ready to be in a play. They enjoy dressing up and rehearsing and they enjoy it even more when their parents come to see the show.

videos.title: Caillou Loves Halloween
videos.overview: It’s trick-or-treat time in Caillou’s neighbourhood. Caillou’s dressed as an astronaut, Leo is a not-very-scary Frankenstein’s monster and Clementine is a nurse. With their parents tagging along, they go door to door, collecting lots of treats.

videos.title: Caillou's Picnic
videos.overview: Caillou invites Leo to go on a family picnic. After lunch they go exploring in the woods and discover an old tree trunk that has fallen down. They pretend that they are brave knights and the tree trunk is a bad dragon. When it begins to rain, Caillou and Leo bravely lead the family to safety.

videos.title: Star Light, Star Bright
videos.overview: Caillou and the family are at Grandma & Grandpa's for an evening corn roast. Everyone marvels at the night sky full of stars--which gives Grandpa the perfect opportunity to bring out his telescope & introduce Caillou to the constellations, planets and the moon.

videos.title: All in a Day's Work
videos.overview: The house wakes up late, and that means it's a mad rush to get Mommy off to work. Later, when Caillou goes for a walk with Daddy he meets all kinds of people doing all kinds of jobs--and he gets to try being a mailman, a sanitation engineer and a policeman for himself. The best part? When he makes the lights and siren goes off in the police car!

videos.title: The Cat's Meow
videos.overview: It's time for Gilbert's annual visit to the vet. Gilbert instinctively knows where he's heading. He hates riding in the car, so Caillou does his best to comfort him--with near-disastrous results! Things only get worse when Gilbert confronts a dog in the waiting room. The vet suggests that Caillou help comfort Gilbert when he gets his shot. That wasn't so bad, was it? MEOW!

videos.title: Caillou in Space
videos.overview: When Caillou plays astronauts with Leo he upsets Rosie. Meanwhile, Grandpa discovers a new planetarium is opening and there's a prize for the best space costume. Caillou is thrilled when the winner turns out to be...a surprise!

videos.title: The Treasure Chest
videos.overview: Caillou is helping Mom clean out the attic. When they come across an old chest, they open it and discover it's full of unexpected things that may not be worth much money, but are treasures none the less.

videos.title: A Camping We Will Go
videos.overview: The family goes away for a weekend of camping in the woods. Caillou is scared when the fish in the lake tickle him. He climbs a mountain with Daddy and really, really hopes he will get to see a moose before it is time to go home.

videos.title: Chopsticks
videos.overview: Caillou has dinner at Sarah's house and discovers new foods and a new way to eat them. He has so much fun learning how to eat with chopsticks he insists on trying them with dessert: Jell-O!

videos.title: A Special Dog
videos.overview: Caillou and Mom meet a fascinating woman in the park. Caillou is quick to approach the woman because she has a friendly dog. He notices it isn't on a leash but in a special harness instead. After several questions she explains she is blind and her dog helps her do many things. Caillou and Mom end up visiting a school where the dogs are taught their special skills.

videos.title: Caillou Beats the Heat
videos.overview: It's hot and steamy and Mom won't let Caillou go to the public pool since they've been every day this week! When Caillou refuses to put on sunscreen lotion and Rosie won't nap, Mom quickly realizes that the hot weather is making everyone grumpy. She and Caillou come up with the perfect solution: they connect the lawn sprinkler for some good-time backyard fun--which certainly doesn't need a lot of sophisticated equipment.

videos.title: Back Seat Driver
videos.overview: Caillou, Dad and Rosie are in the car on their way home. Caillou and Rosie are in the back seat arguing and Dad is losing patience with them. When the car breaks down they have to pull over. Caillou comforts Rosie who becomes afraid when smoke comes out of the engine. Caillou is overjoyed when the tow truck arrives. Everyone rides to the garage and Caillou is in charge of holding Rosie's hand and explaining all the scary sounds.

videos.title: Lost and Found
videos.overview: When Dad and Caillou find a scruffy dog that appears to be lost they bring it home. The whole family pitches in and tries to find the owner by posting signs around the neighborhood. But when the owner arrives, Caillou doesn't want to let the dog go. (Though Gilbert is pretty pleased).

videos.title: Holiday Magic
videos.overview: Caillou and Dad go shopping for a Christmas tree. Amidst the frenzy of holiday shopping they get jostled and pushed every which way. And by the time they get to the tree vendor, all the good trees are gone. Caillou and Dad have a problem: they promised Mom and Rosie they'd get a tree... Together they cook up a plan: They will decorate a tree in their own back yard!

videos.title: Downhill from Here
videos.overview: Mom, an avid skier, takes Caillou downhill skiing while Dad and Rosie sit in the cozy chalet and watch. At first Caillou is frightened by the ski lift, but with Mom's help, he makes it down the hill just fine and has lots of fun. Afterwards, they all get together for tobogganing and a well-deserved hot chocolate before heading out to the hills again.

videos.title: Next Stop... Fun!
videos.overview: Caillou is very excited when the family takes a trip across country by train. After the initial thrill fades and they are settled into their compartment he feels a bit confined in the small quarters. Dad takes Caillou to explore the train--there's so much to see and do. But when it's time to sleep, Caillou wonders where his bed is: it's a foldout bunk bed!

videos.title: Under Sail
videos.overview: Caillou finds an old toy sailing boat Grandpa used to have when he was a kid. It's broken and dusty and Grandpa is about to throw it out, but Grandma says he should restore it. Caillou helps him repair it and paint it, and together they take it to the park to sail it.

videos.title: Farmer Caillou
videos.overview: Caillou visits a farm and spends a day helping the farmer. He rides on a tractor and milks the cows. When a chicken escapes he finds her and to his surprise he learns where eggs come from!

videos.title: Sunday Brunch
videos.overview: Caillou, Dad and Rosie take Mom out for Sunday brunch to celebrate a big event. The meal is at a fancy restaurant and Dad explains to Caillou and Rosie that they have to be on their best behavior. Caillou even wears a tie for the occasion! All goes well until Rosie escapes under the buffet table.

videos.title: Caillou to the Rescue
videos.overview: Gilbert gets caught up a tree, and to Caillou's delight a fire truck full of firefighters has to be called in to rescue him. Dad happens to know one of the firefighters and he and Caillou are invited to ride back to the fire station for a grand tour.

videos.title: Top Bunk
videos.overview: Caillou and Rosie are spending the night at Grandpa and Grandma’s. Caillou doesn’t want to share a room with his sister. But Grandpa surprises them with bunk beds. Caillou is so excited that he has a hard time falling asleep. The room, from high up looks very different and a bit scary. Teddy falls, and Caillou has to come down the ladder to get him back. The top of the ladder looks very tall and far away. When Grandpa and Grandma open the door in the morning, Rosie, Caillou and Teddy are snuggled up together on the bottom bunk.

videos.title: Recipe for Fun
videos.overview: Dad drives Caillou to Grandma's for the day.  When Dad accidentally leaves with Caillou's backpack full of toys, Caillou is upset and decides that there is nothing to do.  Caillou sulks while helping grandma in the garden, until Grandma shows him how he doesn't need his toys to have fun.  Soon Caillou is spending the day making wonderful prints with a potato!

videos.title: New Kids on the Block
videos.overview: An old lot becomes a place of great interest as a house is slowly erected on it. Caillou loves the tractors, diggers and builders. He watches regularly to see the development until one day he discovers that not only is there a new house, but it looks like there might be a new little neighbor. But it turns out there are two! Twins!

videos.title: Off to School
videos.overview: Caillou can’t wait until he is old enough to go to school. Since Sarah has no brother or sister, she invites Caillou to a little brother or sister day at school. The school is big and Caillou is a little afraid. But with Sarah’s help Caillou has a lot of fun, he even draws on the blackboard.

videos.title: Caillou's Kitchen
videos.overview: Caillou is cooking with mom. He is a bit too messy. Dad sends him to play outside, where he is having fun with Sarah pretending to cook. They bring to mom a bouquet of dandelions and a cake made with blocks. Mom sets them on her table.

videos.title: Caillou's Sea Adventure
videos.overview: When Caillou's kite-flying plans are defeated by rain, he creates a pirate ship in his living room. He and Rosie laugh as Gilbert chases the kite "fish" Caillou drags around the room. Dad pretends to be a pirate and play-wrestles on the ship. Lunchtime causes Caillou to think of an indoor picnic and even Gilbert enjoys the rainy-day arrangement.

videos.title: The Little Bird
videos.overview: Caillou and Sarah find a baby bird that fell from its nest. With Sarah’s help Caillou cares for it and protects it from a very interested Gilbert. He’s a bit frightened by the bird at first, but soon grows very attached to it. But soon the bird is ready to fly and Caillou has to let him go.

videos.title: Lights Out!
videos.overview: A winter storm with snow and freezing rain is heading in Caillou’s direction. While preparing dinner, the lights go out. Caillou doesn’t understand how lights turn off by themselves and is very afraid. Mom sets candles on the tables while Caillou and Dad get flashlights. Dad builds a fire in the fireplace and they pretend they’re camping. They even toast marshmallows! At bedtime everybody curls up by the fire in sleeping bags. Caillou wakes up to the sound of the TV. He realizes the power is back on. But everybody is comfy, so they all sleep in the living room anyway.

videos.title: Caillou's Check-Up
videos.overview: It’s time for Caillou’s first visit to the dentist. He thinks it sounds neat until Leo tells him he’s heard terrible things about the dentist. He tells Caillou some crazy stories he heard from his older cousin and now Caillou is not so sure he wants to go. But once he gets there, the dentist is actually really nice and shows him lots of neat stuff. He even gets a special treat!

videos.title: Calling Dr. Caillou
videos.overview: Caillou is really looking forward to a special day with Dad, but Dad gets a bad cold and has to stay home. Caillou is pretty disappointed at first, but then with some help from Mom, Dr. Caillou looks after patient Dad. He brings him a snack, makes him a get-well card, entertains him and ends up having fun.

videos.title: Pumpkin Patch Kid
videos.overview: Dad and Caillou have fun making a jack-o-lantern together. Caillou’s about to throw out all the goop that was inside the pumpkin when Grandma tells him it’s the best part. He finds out what she means when they bake a pumpkin pie.

videos.title: Caillou's Got Rhythm
videos.overview: Caillou spends a day with Grandma and Rosie trying his hand at playing some music. At first what they get is a whole lot of noise, but with Grandma’s help he realizes it can be a lot more fun when they all play together.

videos.title: Do It Yourself
videos.overview: After Caillou sees what Clementine is giving her Dad for Father’s Day, he wants to give his Daddy something just as special but he doesn’t think he has anything nice to give. With some glue, some paint, some Popsicle sticks and a little help from Grandpa he makes his own present for Dad. Caillou is not sure if Dad will like it, but Dad says it’s the best present ever because Caillou made it himself.

videos.title: Caillou's Big Sale
videos.overview: Caillou is very excited about the neighborhood rummage sale until he’s asked to figure out what he’d like to contribute. He’s not so sure he wants to part with any of his toys. But in the end he’s pretty happy with the new stuff he comes home with.

videos.title: One, Two, Boom!
videos.overview: It’s night. A thunderstorm is raging outside. Caillou and Gilbert are afraid. They take refuge in Caillou’s closet until Daddy comes and rescues them. Over a cup of hot chocolate Dad tells Caillou about the counting game Grandma taught him. Playing the game, Caillou relaxes. He goes back to bed. While in bed, Dad and Caillou play the shadow game. With the storm moving away, Caillou, with Gilbert by his side, feels happy and safe again.

videos.title: Out of the Woods
videos.overview: Caillou and his friends from the daycare are going for a treasure hunt in the forest. Caillou learns about all kinds of animals and trees, and also not to go away from the group or you can get lost. Caillou discovers a nice rock that turns out to be a turtle.

videos.title: House Paint
videos.overview: Caillou decides that he can do everything by himself. To show dad that he can help to paint the porch with him, Caillou paints Rosie’s doll’s house. When Caillou comes back with dad to show him the good job he did, Gilbert’s painted paws are all over the room. Caillou and dad have to clean up the mess. Caillou is really proud dad gave him a mini paint roller to fix Rosie’s Doll’s house.

videos.title: Caillou's Thanksgiving
videos.overview: Caillou helps Mom and Dad prepare the meal for Thanksgiving, but the pile of leaves outside is more appealing and more fun. Caillou goes to play in them with Gilbert. Later Mom asks him to set the table. Caillou messes up the Thanksgiving centerpiece. He doesn’t understand what all the fuss is about. Mom explains Thanksgiving Day to him. Caillou decides to be more help. He finishes the table and adds his own special decorations. He is very proud when his family enjoys what he has done.

videos.title: Say Cheese
videos.overview: Dad lends Caillou his old camera. But between his fingers in the lens and his subject that runs away, Caillou is ready to abandon it all. With Dad as an assistant Caillou takes great pictures of every member of the family, Gilbert included. The last one is the entire family together, Caillou included.

videos.title: Finder's Keepers
videos.overview: Caillou and Leo can’t find Caillou’s airplane anywhere but their hunt through the house turns up all sort of other lost items. They make a big mess along the way and when they clean it up they discover that the airplane was right under their noses.

videos.title: A Frog in Caillou's Throat
videos.overview: After getting caught in the rain, Caillou loses his voice. He’s very surprised to learn he has a frog in his throat, but manages to find a whole new way of communicating with his family until the frog goes away.

videos.title: Caillou the Great
videos.overview: After seeing Bravo the magician doing some tricks at Leo’s birthday party; Caillou decides that he is Caillou the Great. With magic words, Caillou makes his magic penny and Gilbert, disappear and reappear. Mom, Dad and Rosie clap and cheer him. He even makes up few tricks of his own.

videos.title: Clowning Around
videos.overview: Caillou is upset because he couldn’t stay and play with Leo. To cheer him up, Grandma gets out a pop-up book about clowns. Caillou forgot all about wanting to play with Leo. Grandma and Caillou decide to make puppet clowns and the theatre box. Mom and Rosie are back just in time for the show. Everybody has a great time.

videos.title: Read All About It
videos.overview: Caillou and Mom go to the library for story time. Caillou has scribbled on one of the books he borrowed, and is afraid to bring it back. Clementine’s Mom who is in charge of story time cleans the book. Caillou takes home a new book and this time, he will be extra careful with it.

videos.title: Mom For a Day
videos.overview: Mom is gone for the day. While helping Dad on the daily routine, Caillou realizes he knows how Mom does lots of things, especially with Rosie. Caillou loves helping Dad.

videos.title: Caillou Plays Baseball
videos.overview: When Dad and Grandpa watch TV Caillou discovers baseball for the first time. He wants to play and patiently Dad works at teaching him. Caillou is all ready to throw in the towel as each toss passes him by, but when he sees Sarah and Billy really doing it he gets an opportunity to practice what he's learned and succeed. A few more lessons and Caillou is on his way to becoming a neighborhood baseball player.

videos.title: Comic Caper!
videos.overview: Caillou and Dad are settling down for their favorite weekend ritual of reading the paper. Caillou can’t wait to see his favorite comic strip, but thanks to an ill-timed gust of wind and a very mischievous cat, Caillou has to exercise some patience and persistence before he can finally enjoy it.

videos.title: Hide and Seek
videos.overview: Caillou is upset when dad and mom make him play with Rosie when all he wants is to play by himself. While Caillou is making a fort for her, she disappears. With mom and dad’s help, Caillou finds Rosie. It’s lots of fun to play hide and seek with Rosie, Mom and Dad.

videos.title: Caillou's Clouds
videos.overview: Caillou, Mom and Rosie go to the park for a picnic and bring a kite. Unfortunately, there isn't much wind, and Caillou can't get the kite to fly. Mom suggests waiting a while, and while he waits, Caillou looks up at the clouds and sees all kinds of things: a wagon, a giant balloon and a dinosaur. He's disappointed when the wind picks up and blows the clouds away, but then he remembers his kite!

videos.title: Caillou Cleans Up
videos.overview: Mom and Dad are busy with spring-cleaning and Caillou wants to help. After a couple of ill-fated attempts, Mom and Dad give Caillou his very own chore to do and with no thanks to Gilbert, he does it all by himself.

videos.title: Caillou and the Tooth Fairy
videos.overview: Caillou and Sarah are playing together when Caillou notices his friend wiggling her loose tooth back and forth. He asks her about it and she crouches down to show him. She uses her tongue to wiggle it back and forth, explaining that soon it will fall out. At first Caillou is horrified. Sarah laughs and tells him baby teeth are supposed to fall out. It makes room for the grown-up teeth. And besides, when you start losing teeth, the tooth fairy brings you presents. That gets Caillou's attention.

videos.title: I Want to Grow Up
videos.overview: Caillou wants to be taller like his friend Jim and tries to think of a way to grow faster. Mom and Dad measure him on his growth chart and show him he has grown a whole inch since last time, but that’s just not enough. Later when a plumbing problem requires someone small to help out, Caillou finds out there are some benefits to being just his size.

videos.title: The Big Chill
videos.overview: Caillou is excited about the arrival of spring, but he’s a little disappointed when Dad says there’ll be no more snow. So when he finds a patch of snow under the porch, he gets a great idea to save it so he can have winter fun all summer long.

videos.title: Leo's Hamster
videos.overview: Caillou loves Leo’s pet hamster and would really like to have his own, so he is thrilled when he gets to look after it while Leo and his parents are out of town. But he soon discovers that the job is a lot of hard work, especially with Gilbert around!

videos.title: Three's a Crowd
videos.overview: Caillou, Mom and Rosie go to the park, where they join Leo and Clementine already playing in the sandbox. Accidentally Caillou breaks a part of the sand castle as well as Clementine’s bucket. They are mad at him. Caillou is sad his friends don’t want to play with him. He offers his bucket to replace the broken one and helps them to finish the sand castle. They are his friends again.

videos.title: Get Well Soon
videos.overview: Caillou and Leo are having a great time playing when Leo trips and falls, hurting his ankle. Caillou is very worried about Leo and thinks it may be his fault Leo got hurt. But when he makes Leo a get-well card and visits him at home, Leo says it wasn’t Caillou’s fault he didn’t tie his shoelaces.

videos.title: Shadow Play
videos.overview: After supper one night, Caillou and Jason and Jeffrey decide to play hide and seek in the backyard.  It sounds like a lot of fun at first, but as the sun set things in the backyard take on a spooky appearance and being scared doesn't seem much fun anymore.

videos.title: A New Member of the Family
videos.overview: Caillou, Mom and Rosie are looking at pictures, and reminisce about the very first time Dad brought Gilbert home. He was just a little kitten.

videos.title: Surprise Party
videos.overview: Caillou and Rosie are at Grandma’s. To his surprise Caillou discovers that Grandpa’s birthday was last week and he had no birthday party. How could a birthday be a birthday without a party! Caillou decides to give Grandpa one. With Grandma's help, he gets everything ready, even the candles on the cake. Surprise! Grandpa is very surprised and very happy.

videos.title: Caillou's Bad Dream
videos.overview: After a scary nightmare, Caillou doesn’t want to sleep in his own bed anymore and sneaks into Mommy and Daddy’s. Mommy and Daddy are wakened by his tossing and turning and are very surprised to find him in their bed. With their help Caillou comes up with some creative ways to enjoy sleeping in his own room again.

videos.title: Caillou Computes
videos.overview: Caillou is very excited when Dad brings home a computer. His friend Clementine has one at her house and gets to play fun games on it. But Caillou is not the only one who wants to use the computer and he has learn to share it with the whole family even Gilbert!

videos.title: Caillou's Big Discovery
videos.overview: While playing dinosaurs in the backyard, Caillou and Leo dig up a fish fossil rock. They clean it and decide to bring it to the library and have it exhibited beside the dinosaur fossil.

videos.title: Caillou Goes to the Car Wash
videos.overview: Caillou, Dad and Rosie take the car to the car wash. It’s Rosie’s first time and she is a bit scared. But Caillou reassures her by explaining everything to her.

videos.title: Far Away Home
videos.overview: Caillou, Rosie and Julie the baby-sitter travel to all sorts of pretend far away places. Among them are the desert with its camel and oasis, the big mountain they climb and finally the river and waterfalls in the steamy tropical forest.

videos.title: All You Can Eat!
videos.overview: While preparing the picnic lunch with Mom, Caillou tests a bit too much of everything. He has no room left to eat the special sandwich Clementine made for him. His appetite comes back while watching squirrels storing food in their houses for the winter.

videos.title: Caillou Stays Up Late
videos.overview: Dad and Mom are having a grown-up party. Caillou is sad he is not invited. Caillou finds excuses to drop in the dining room far past his bedtime. The next morning everybody at the table looks sleepy and tired.

videos.title: Backyard Zoo
videos.overview: Caillou, Clementine and Leo are disappointed they can’t go to the zoo. With Mom and Dad’s help Clementine is a zebra, Leo a bear and Caillou a turtle.

videos.title: Scavenger Hunt
videos.overview: Caillou, Rosie and Julie, their babysitter, go on a scavenger hunt. Back home they decide to make a craft with the elements and surprise Mom and Dad with it.

videos.title: Too Many Cooks
videos.overview: When Julie is late for baby-sitting. Mom calls around to find help. Mr. Hinkle from across the street is glad to baby-sit and Miss Martin hears that Mom needs help and comes too. Finally Julie shows up. Caillou has more help than he needs, but he invites everybody to stay for a piece of cake.

videos.title: The Berry Patch
videos.overview: Caillou is invited to spend the day with Clementine's family and he's a bit nervous. But he soon he discovers that Clementine's family is a lot like his. He has a wonderful day and tops it all off with a strawberry for Teddy!

videos.title: Caillou's Suitcase
videos.overview: When Dad gives Caillou his old suitcase Caillou is thrilled. And for the first time ever, he gets to pack it himself. This brings him to a dilemma when he discovers that if he takes his toys, there is no room for clothes. Mom helps Caillou think about what he'll need and soon he is well packed and on his way.

videos.title: Try, Try Again
videos.overview: Mom shows Caillou how to tie his shoes but he get frustrated and stops trying. Caillou learns in watching Rosie that you can succeed if you keep trying.

videos.title: New Leaf
videos.overview: Caillou, Grandpa and Dad go for a special hike in the woods. Caillou has to catch a falling leaf before it touches the ground. After a while he gets frustrated but Grandpa tells him to try and try again, that is the only way. And it pays off!

videos.title: Happy New Year
videos.overview: Caillou meets Lee-Wun Sarah’s cousin. She is here for the Chinese New Year. Caillou learns about the New Year's coin and the red posters with good wishes. He even tries some Chinese delicacies, but most of all he gets to see the famous dragon dance.

videos.title: Caillou's Cross Word
videos.overview: When Caillou learns a mean word from an older child, he uses it on Clementine and hurts her feelings. When Mom finds out, she asks Caillou to apologize, which he does, and soon the two are friends again.

videos.title: Caillou Meets Robbie
videos.overview: At the park Caillou meets a little boy and tries to make friends with him. He mistakes the boy’s silence for rudeness until he discovers that Robbie is deaf and can’t hear him. Caillou learns how to play with Robbie and soon they develop a language of their own. Caillou even learns the word for friend in sign language.

videos.title: The Piñata
videos.overview: Caillou waits impatiently for the mail. He is expecting an invitation to Xavier’s birthday party. When it arrives he finds out it isn’t just any birthday party; it’s a fiesta and takes place in the park. A piñata hangs from a tree with a surprise inside it. Caillou is anxious to know what the surprise is inside. On his second turn he finds out. Candies tumble all around him!

videos.title: Caillou's Promise
videos.overview: Caillou learns the importance of keeping a promise and even though they aren't always that much fun to keep, the reward for Caillou is a circus and well worth his effort.

videos.title: A Surprise for Mommy
videos.overview: Dad can’t think of a surprise for Mom, and nor can Caillou. When Clementine comes out of a photographer’s studio holding a portrait, Dad and Caillou are thrilled. They keep the secret from Mom and the next day surprises her with a portrait of Caillou and Rosie beaming.

videos.title: Caillou Misses Sarah
videos.overview: Sarah helps Caillou paint a birdhouse Dad built, but she can't stay and finish it because she is off on an all-summer trip to China. Caillou and his family take care of Sarah's house and look after Ollie. Caillou misses her very much. On the day of her return, Caillou is ecstatic and anxious to show Sarah that not only is the birdhouse finished and hanging in a tree, it has a resident.

videos.title: Caillou's T-shirt Trouble
videos.overview: When Caillou's brand new T-shirt is ruined by grape juice Grandma diverts disaster by recycling it and turning into a one-of-a-kind shirt that is tie-dyed with grape-juice star bursts. Caillou likes it even better than before and is happy to have been the artist.

videos.title: A Helping Hand
videos.overview: Grandma is doggie sitting Rover. She and Caillou visit her friends in the Seniors’ Home and Rover goes with them. Caillou meets a lot of Grandma’s friends and tries to keep Rover out of trouble. When Rover runs away, Caillou finds him by hearing a sneeze from Mr. Jenkins who is allergic to dogs.

videos.title: Caillou Tries Karate
videos.overview: Leo comes over to play at Caillou’s house. They have fun pretending to be bears until Sarah shows up wearing a GY (white Karate outfit). Dad had promised to drive her to her Karate lesson. Sarah introduces Caillou and Leo to Karate and demonstrates a few moves. While she is at her class, the boys have their own pretend Karate game. When Sarah comes back, she gives another lesson to the whole family.

videos.title: Just Like Daddy
videos.overview: Daddy has a list of things to do around the house. However, the list soon disappears thanks to Gilbert who has decided to take off with it. Mom and Rosie go to the store, Caillou stays at home with his Daddy, and has a lot of fun imitating him and helping him with the chores Dad remembers from the missing list.

videos.title: Caillou's Safari
videos.overview: Caillou wants to play with his animal cards but they have disappeared. A search soon reveals that Rosie has been playing with them, scattering them around the house. Caillou’s new mission: to find them! So Caillou and Rosie head out on a safari, working together to find the animal cards.

videos.title: Cowboy Caillou
videos.overview: Jonas, a friend of Dad’s and a real cowboy, has invited the family to visit his ranch. Caillou had never met a real cowboy before. Caillou learns a lot about horses: they like carrots, they wear shoes… And he even gets to brush a pony named Lucky. Jonas also has a great surprise for them all. He takes them on a wagon ride and gives Caillou a terrific souvenir: his very own cowboy hat!

videos.title: Caillou's Coins
videos.overview: Caillou accompanies Mom to the grocery store and brings along some money from his piggybank. He gets his own shopping cart and helps Mom gather the things on the grocery list. Caillou finds a way to spend his money: he gets his face painted by a lady at the store. Back home, Caillou has a surprise for Rosie: he gives her a helium-filled balloon that the face-painting lady gave him.

videos.title: Caillou's Canoe Trip
videos.overview: When Caillou, Grandpa and Daddy go on a canoe trip, Caillou gets to see some wild animals in their natural habitat. He is amazed to see a dragonfly, a blue heron, and a beaver working on his beaver lodge. When they get to the cabin, they gather wood for the campfire and Caillou learns how to roast marshmallows on the fire.

videos.title: Caillou and the Bulldozer
videos.overview: On an autumn day, Caillou and his Mommy take a walk and pass by a construction site. Caillou loves to watch the big bulldozer and starts to pretend he is one too. Back home, not everyone likes Bulldozer-Caillou as he chases Gilbert with his dust pan/bulldozer shovel and destroys Rosie’s block tower. Caillou helps Rosie build a new tower and finally finds a perfect job for a bulldozer: bulldozing the leaves with Dad in the backyard.

videos.title: Caillou the Firefighter
videos.overview: When Dad’s burning toasts trigger the fire alarm, he decides it is the perfect opportunity to practice a fire drill. Caillou gets the family together and after going over a basic evacuation plan, Dad starts the alarm once more and everyone rushes outside to a meeting point. Caillou happily spends the afternoon outside pretending to be a firefighter.

videos.title: Caillou the Timekeeper
videos.overview: Caillou and his Mommy are finishing preparing a picnic lunch. Caillou would like to leave right away, but it’s not lunch time yet and Mom and Dad have other things to finish before they leave. Caillou goes back and forth between Mom and Dad to check if it is time to go. To help Caillou wait, Dad gives him a small alarm clock and a special assignment; to let everybody know when it’s noon (when the two hands on the clock reach twelve).

videos.title: Elephants!
videos.overview: When Mom, Rosie and Caillou go to the zoo, Caillou can’t wait to see the elephants. Rosie is a bit uneasy with all of these animals around and it takes her a while to get used to them; but, each time they leave a station, the animals seem to “connect” with Rosie one way or another which finally makes her smile. They see a parrot, a monkey, a hippopotamus and finally the elephants! Caillou is in complete awe and comes to the realization that animals have families too.

videos.title: Caillou and the Sheep
videos.overview: Grandma takes Caillou on a special visit to a sheep farm. There, Mary, a 10-year-old girl, takes Caillou on a tour, teaching him about sheep, sheering, and the spinning of wool. When a small lamb escapes in the barn, Caillou helps Mary bring it back its his box.

videos.title: Caillou and the Puppies
videos.overview: Caillou and Dad go over to Mr. Hinkle’s house to help him build a dog house. Caillou soon meets Mr. Hinkle’s guests, a Mommy dog with her two puppies, who are staying with him for a few days. When one of the puppies disappears, Caillou helps look for him. Fortunately, the bold little puppy comes out of hiding and joins his family in their new home.

videos.title: The Duck Family
videos.overview: While Caillou and his family are on a picnic at the park, his beach ball accidentally rolls into a pond. Caillou sees a family of ducks swimming in the pond and wants to take a closer look. Dad shows Caillou a neat trick to call the ducks. They hide behind some bushes and the ducks come out of the water. They find Caillou’s missing ball and head home where a special surprise is waiting for Caillou at bath time.

videos.title: Clementine's New Pet
videos.overview: When Mom takes Caillou to Clementine’s to see her new pet, she won’t tell Caillou what kind of animal it is. She wants it to be a surprise. Caillou soon discovers that Clemmentine’s new pet is a goldfish named Goldie! Clemmentine teaches Caillou how to feed him. Clementine and Caillou play with Goldie by holding toys against the glass of the fish bowl… After a snack, Caillou and Clementine decide to make drawings of Goldie and are amazed when the fish seems to look at the pictures when they hold it against the fish bowl.

videos.title: Disappearing Carrots
videos.overview: When a white rabbit eats a bunch of carrots set aside for a picnic lunch, Caillou and Rosie go looking him. Caillou is just about to give up when the rabbit shows up. They soon discover that it isn’t a wild rabbit, his name is Snowball and he belongs to Mr. Hinkle’s sister.

videos.title: Caillou Marches On
videos.overview: When Caillou visits Clementine, he is impressed to see Billy practicing on a Tuba. Billy shows Caillou and Clementine a little bit about the tuba and plays a musical game with them. Soon, Billy’s marching band mates arrive to practice. Clementine and Caillou wish they could join in too. They make their own pretend horns with cardboard tubes. When Billy’s sheet music is lifted away by a gust of wind, Caillou catches it and saves the day for the band! They all march on, giving Caillou a musical escort back to his house.

videos.title: Who's Mooing?
videos.overview: Caillou and his family are leaving for a picnic in the country but the ride feels very long for Caillou, especially since he cannot play with his toy airplane because he might wake Rosie. When they stop at a gas station, Caillou spots some cows in a field next to a picnic area. The family decides to have the picnic there, where they have a close encounter with some cows.

videos.title: Follow That Sound!
videos.overview: On a winter evening, a strange sound grabs Caillou’s attention. Caillou first searches the living room but the sound seems to come from elsewhere. He follows the sound to find out its source. His quest takes him to see Dad in the basement where the sound is heard again. Caillou continues his search and discovers Gilbert in his room, having a great time playing with a baby toy.

videos.title: The Music Box
videos.overview: Caillou goes up to the attic with Mom and finds a box containing a teddy bear and a music box. Mom gives the bear a bandanna, transforming him into a pirate bear. Caillou decides he likes the bear more than the music box. Since Caillou has made his choice, Mom decides to give Rosie the music box. When Caillou realizes that the music box was still working he wants it back. Caillou and Rosie find a way to both get to play with the music box and the pirate bear.

videos.title: Caillou's Gym Day
videos.overview: Caillou gets a special invitation to go to André’s gym class. A little intimidated at first, Caillou tries his best and ends up having great fun. When they make a rhythmic coordination exercise, Caillou discovers that not everything is easy! Caillou finds the leap-frog exercise difficult but he keeps trying and finally succeeds. Back home, André and Caillou play gym class and when Caillou finds a toy whistle, it’s his turn to be the gym teacher!

videos.title: Our Rocket Ship
videos.overview: Caillou and Leo are playing with their rocket ships in the park. Rosie wants to help them build the space station but she accidentally wrecks it. Caillou’s frustration builds up when they have to go home because of Rosie’s nap. At home, Caillou and Leo continue their space game and are thrilled when Mr. Hinkle gives them a cardboard box which they transform into a rocket ship. They all work very hard to decorate it. When Rosie comes out to help, Caillou is worried she’s going to wreck it and doesn’t want her help. But with Mommy’s help, Rosie makes the perfect final touch for the rocket ship: a flag! Caillou realizes that Rosie can help too and invites her to join him on the first mission in their new rocket ship!

videos.title: Caillou Helps Grandpa
videos.overview: On a winter day, Dad and Caillou go over to Grandpa’s with their skates. What was suppose to be a skating outing becomes a shoveling chore because of all the snow that has accumulated in Grandpa’s driveway. Soon, Caillou finds a way to turn this into a game and has a lot of fun making snow castles. When they are finally done and ready to go skating, the snowplow passes in front of Grandpa’s and leaves more snow to shovel. Still, Caillou is delighted: they can make plenty of new snow castles!

videos.title: Backyard Bowlers
videos.overview: When Caillou and Rosie stay at Grandma and Grandpa’s house, Grandpa uses pop bottles and a rubber ball to create a kid’s bowling alley in the backyard. Grandpa teaches Caillou to bowl, but when he is called inside, it’s Caillou’s turn to teach as he shows Rosie how to play. Rosie and Caillou have a great time playing together and when they come in for a snack they have another surprise: Grandma has made a little bowling trophy for each of them.

videos.title: Caillou's Milk Run
videos.overview: Caillou accidentally spills the rest of the milk before Rosie could get her cereal. She is very upset and Caillou suggests they go get some more milk at the corner store. On their way there, Caillou is proud to show things to his Mommy. He picks up a piece of chalk left on the sidewalk and draws a smiley face. At the street intersection, he shows Mom that he knows when it is time to cross safely. Mom is also proud of him. They get some milk and bread and come back home. Caillou can’t wait to eat cereal too but is disappointed when he finds out there is only enough cereal for Rosie! Rosie graciously agrees to share the cereal with her big brother and they have a great snack together.

videos.title: Dancing at Grandma's
videos.overview: It is a rainy day and Caillou is disappointed because he will not be able to go play at the park with Grandma. Caillou’s mood changes when he discovers an old photo of a younger Grandpa and Grandma dancing. He gets more excited when he finds a first-prize ribbon they won at a dancing contest. He wants to dance too! With Grandma as his partner, Caillou follows her lead and learns to dance in the living room. Soon Caillou is even inventing his own steps! The dance goes on and the park is long forgotten, even if the weather has changed and the sun is now shinning outside.

videos.title: Mystery Valentine
videos.overview: It’s Valentine’s day and Caillou is invited to a Valentine’s party at his best friend Leo’s house. Caillou is excited and with Mom’s help, he prepares special Valentine cards for his friends. When he gets to the party and hands out his Valentine’s cards, he finds a mysterious Valentine card addressed to him! It’s not from anyone at the party. A little investigation back home leads him to his secret admirer: a little sister with a big heart.

videos.title: Play Ball!
videos.overview: When Dad’s baseball team, the Tigers, are playing a game at the park, Caillou, Rosie and Mom, go to cheer him on. However, Caillou gets restless. He wants to participate too. Although he’s too little to go up and bat, he becomes part of the team as the water boy and does a great job. When Dad’s game is over, they take out Caillou’s toy baseball gear and have a baseball game of their own.

videos.title: Dogsled Ahead!
videos.overview: Caillou and his family are heading to the tobogganing hill! What fun it is to climb the hill and race down surrounded by people having a good time. Caillou is curious when they see a sled dog and his master giving a sled show on the premises. Caillou watches in wonder as the dog obeys the vocal commands. He’s even more impressed when he gets to ride the sled with Rosie and the dog listens to him!

videos.title: Caillou's Sleepover Guest
videos.overview: Leo is spending the night at Caillou’s. Mom, Dad and Caillou provide him with all he needs: a sleeping bag to sleep in and a new toothbrush. Caillou would like all these special treats too but he learns that the guest comes first. Although Caillou gets a bit frustrated by this, he has a change of heart when he sees that Leo misses home a bit. Caillou decides to lend Leo his favorite dinosaur pajamas. The two friends find a perfect solution to make them both happy and have the best sleep-over ever!

videos.title: Games in the Park
videos.overview: Caillou is excited when Miss Martin takes him and his friends to the park for some special activities. They have a beanbag race: a relay race using one beanbag per team. All these rules are not easy to grasp, and the kids have a few comical mishaps in the process. Caillou discovers that you don’t always have to win to be proud of yourself.

videos.title: The Sugar Shack
videos.overview: When Caillou’s family makes a springtime visit Jonas’ ranch, he takes them on a sleigh ride to a maple forest where Caillou discovers how the maple sap is collected from maple trees and gets to help to collect some. Later on in the sugar shack, Caillou learns about the maple syrup transformation process. But the best surprise is outside when Jonas pours the hot maple toffee on the snow, for everyone to enjoy.

videos.title: Winter Mystery
videos.overview: The twins, Jason and Jeffrey, have come to play with Caillou in the snow. They have fun playing games and making tracks in the snow until they discover smaller tracks between the two trees. A closer investigation leads them to a mischievous and playful squirrel who soon has them running around the yard. Exhausted, they drop in the snow and make some tracks of their own: snow angels.

videos.title: Caillou's Snow Day
videos.overview: When Caillou, Rosie and Mom head to the big park, Caillou sees André and they decide to build a snow fort. It is not easy but Caillou likes to learn from André and they put a lot of effort into building it. Sarah shows up and the boys put the fort to the test as they start a fun snow fight. In the end, they decide that the fort could be higher and everyone pitches in to help.

videos.title: Caillou's Favorite Plate
videos.overview: Grandma has given Caillou a special spaceship plate. Caillou loves it so much that he carries it everywhere with him and he wants to eat every meal from it. Caillou is disappointed when he can’t find the plate. He searches the whole house but still can’t find it. Soon Caillou discovers that Rosie accidentally hid it in the kitchen while playing with bowls and lids. Caillou is very happy to have his favorite plate again. His snack even seems to taste better on it.

videos.title: Fun in the Mud
videos.overview: It’s raining outside but there is no stopping Caillou! Since no one wants to join him, he goes outside to play in his new froggie boots, his rain coat and hat. He has a great time walking through water, making holes in the wet sand of the sand box, and making mud soup. He sees a robin catch a worm and is thrilled when he finds a worm of his own. When Leo calls to invite Caillou over to play, Caillou isn’t sure at first if he wants to go since he’s having such a great time by himself but, he decides that he wants to show his worm to Leo and heads off to see his friend.

videos.title: All Aboard!
videos.overview: After finding a photograph of a four-year-old Dad with a model train set, Caillou and Dad decide to look for it in Grandpa’s basement. After a while, they finally find it and set it up to test it out. Caillou is having a great time; Grandpa, Dad and Caillou all love toy trains. Grandma captures the moment in a photograph which Caillou decides to put in the photo album beside the old picture of Dad.

videos.title: Gilbert's House
videos.overview: When Caillou spots a dog house outside he gets the idea that Gilbert might like a house of his own. Caillou finds a cardboard box and some crayons and with Gilbert’s help, he decides how to decorate the house. Once done, Gilbert’s new house is a success!

videos.title: I Scream for Ice Cream!
videos.overview: Caillou, Rosie and Mom are having fun at the park when the ice-cream man comes around. Caillou wants an ice-cream but the ice-cream man leaves before he can get there. Caillou is very frustrated and complains to Dad when they get home. Dad has an idea and Caillou cools off by riding his bicycle. When Caillou rings his bicycle bell, Dad suggests Caillou be the ice-cream man! Caillou is delighted by the idea. Soon, lots of “customers” join him in the kitchen to get one of his unique ice-cream creations.

videos.title: Super Caillou!
videos.overview: Caillou just loves his Superbear storybook. Dad reads it to him once but when Caillou wants to hear it again and again, Dad explains that he has other things to do. Caillou decides to make up a story on his own and plays it out with Rosie. “Superbear” and “Lttle Bear” run after the villain Gilbert AKA “Bad-Bazoo-Bear” and save the day. When they get to the kitchen a real task awaits them! Mom can’t find her car keys. “Superbear” is quick to check around and finds them. Mom is very proud of her two super heroes.

videos.title: Trip On The Subway
videos.overview: Caillou learns to deal with a change in plans, when Daddy has to use the car and Mommy and Caillou have to take the subway. Caillou learns, a change in plans can be fun, checking out the map, getting tickets and listening to the musicians! In fact he has so much fun, he and Mom decide to take the subway home!

videos.title: Caillou's Race
videos.overview: Caillou is playing a board game with Mom and he gets a little upset when he discovers that her last die throw is going to make her win. He tries to change the rules but Mom stands her ground. These are the rules and you can’t always win. Upset, Caillou takes a time out by himself. After a little while, he decides he wants to play again. He races Teddy, Gilbert and eventually Rosie who turns out to have a few tricks of her own!

videos.title: As Good As New
videos.overview: Caillou learns about ‘recycling’ -- literally! When Caillou gets an eyeful of Leo’s new bicycle, he wishes his bike looked special too. So when Dad suggests they shine up his bike, Caillou’s all for it! They decorate it with their own streamers and Mom comes through with a new horn too!

videos.title: I, Robot
videos.overview: When Sarah shows Caillou and Leo her new remote controlled robot, the boys get a great idea to be robots too! They have fun taking turns ‘controlling’ each other with their own remote control. Mom even gets into the act, but when their ‘batteries’ go dead in the middle of a snack, Mom has to use the emergency ‘wind up key’.

videos.title: Caillou's Water Park
videos.overview: Caillou learns that the best fun is made up and not bought and paid for. When he sees a flyer in the mail about a fun looking water park, he wants to go! But Mom says it’s not a good day for it and Caillou is disappointed. That is until they come up with an idea to make their very own water park in the backyard!

videos.title: Gone Fishing
videos.overview: Caillou learns about patience when he goes fishing with Daddy and Grandpa at the pier. He even watches a boat bring in a load of fish! But learning about patience is hard, can Caillou wait long enough to catch his own fish?

videos.title: The Water Goes 'Round
videos.overview: Grandma is watching Caillou for the day, and he wants her to play trucks with him. But Grandma has a better idea; why not help do the laundry? She makes such a great game of it, Caillou wants to play it again and again. The only trouble is, the laundry is all done! Caillou learns about helping out, and that it can be fun too!

videos.title: Caillou's Test Drive
videos.overview: When their car breaks down, the family goes shopping for a new one. Caillou has never seen so many shiny cars and especially likes the one with ‘no roof’ that they go for a ride in. In the end, Mom and Dad decide to fix up their car, which makes Caillou happy.

videos.title: A Very Good Swimmer!
videos.overview: Caillou gets an introduction to what it means to be handicapped, when, at the pool, he meets Tammy, a girl a few years older, who happens to be in a wheelchair. Caillou hardly even notices Tammy’s handicap, all he knows is, she’s a great swimmer! She even shows Caillou a few aquatic tricks!

videos.title: Caillou's Horn
videos.overview: When Sarah gives Caillou an old toy horn, Caillou wants to blow it everywhere. But he quickly learns, not everyone wants to hear it all the time. Caillou is frustrated, until Dad suggests they go to the park. There, Caillou uses the horn to signal Sarah from afar. There is a time and place for everything!

videos.title: The Mighty Oak
videos.overview: When Mr. Hinkle has a tree cut down, Caillou is afraid his swing tree is next! Dad decides to plant a new tree so it’s a trip to the Nursery. Caillou learns about the differences between trees with needles and leaves. When the new tree is planted, Caillou gives it a blanket to keep warm and a toy car to play with in case it gets lonely at night.

videos.title: Get Well Mr. Hinkle
videos.overview: When Caillou dresses up like a mailman to deliver Mr. Hinkle’s misdirected mail, he finds out Mr. Hinkle is sick. With help from Mom, Caillou makes up a get-well card, and together they deliver it, along with some much needed chicken soup!

videos.title: The Big Boat
videos.overview: Caillou and family go on a trip on Helen’s boat, an old friend of Mom’s. Caillou is surprised to find there’s a whole house packed into the boat. Caillou learns about wind and sails, and even gets to steer the boat too!

videos.title: Something For Everyone
videos.overview: When the park is closed for the day, Caillou’s friends come over to his house to play. But when no one will share the sandbox toys, or the swing, Caillou wishes everyone would just go home. Mom proposes a game everyone can play, so Caillou suggests Frozen Tag! When it’s time for everyone to go home, Caillou wonders, can’t his friends stay just a little longer?

videos.title: Skating Lessons
videos.overview: When Mom drives Sarah to her skating lesson, Caillou decides he wants to take skating lessons too! But the lessons are harder than Caillou expected, and if it weren’t for the neato Zamboni, Caillou might not have gone back. But the second lesson proves to be a lot of fun, and Caillou gets a ride on the Zamboni too!

videos.title: Caillou Becomes A Waiter
videos.overview: When Mom and Dad are getting ready to go out to a restaurant, Caillou doesn’t understand why he can’t go too! He’s disappointed until Julie the babysitter suggests they make their own restaurant, complete with menus! Everyone dresses up and Caillou and Julie take turns being waiters!

videos.title: Sticking To It!
videos.overview: When Caillou accidentally breaks one of his toys because his room is a mess, Mom suggests a way to make cleaning up fun: with colourful stickers and a chart. Now Caillou and Rosie get to pick out their very own stickers for brushing their teeth, and more importantly, cleaning up the toys in their bedrooms!

videos.title: New Clothes
videos.overview: When Caillou dresses himself, he learns it’s okay to change from your favourite shorts when you find out it’s cold outside. And when you put your pants on backwards, you can change and put them on right. So when he sees Dad and Grandpa in suits and ties for a big party, he changes into his grownup clothes too.

videos.title: Where I Live
videos.overview: When an invitation for Clementine’s party accidentally ends up at Sarah’s, Caillou learns the differences between the addresses of the two homes. Daddy helps by making up a rhyme. Caillou learns his address, and is able to recite it back to Clementine.

videos.title: A Good Friend
videos.overview: When Leo forgets his brand new toy dinosaur in the park, Daddy and Caillou go looking for it. With no success, Caillou, with Mommy’s help, puts up a Lost and Found Poster, and then, finds ‘Dino’ at the Park Office Lost and Found!

videos.title: Just Like Me
videos.overview: When Clementine tells Caillou how much she likes her older brother, Billy, to teach her things, Caillou sets out to teach something to Rosie. But this proves harder than Caillou thought, until Mom suggests he try the A-B-C song!

videos.title: Just In Time
videos.overview: When Caillou’s dawdling causes he, Mom and Rosie to be late going to the park, they end up missing Leo. So Dad suggests they make a game out of not dawdling, by using an egg timer for Caillou to race against when he gets ready for bed. This time, Caillou isn’t distracted, and now has time to have three stories read to him!

videos.title: Mr. Fixit
videos.overview: When the washing machine needs fixing, Caillou ends up helping Bob the repairman. Inspired, Caillou helps Dad hammer a nail and glue the leg onto a wobbly stool too!

videos.title: Where's Gilbert
videos.overview: Gilbert has gone missing and Caillou is very concerned. A search of the neighbourhood and the local animal shelter turns up nothing. Caillou thinks about what it would be like to have other kinds of pets, but concludes that Gilbert is the perfect pet and he wants him back! Luckily when they return home Gilbert is waiting for them on the porch.

videos.title: Where I Saw it Last
videos.overview: After a day in the park and a visit to an ice cream parlour with Jeffrey and Jason, Caillou realizes that he has misplaced his new toy car. Mom encourages him to remember where he saw it last. The last place Caillou remembers having it is in the ice cream parlour. When they return Caillou is happy to find that the waitress has his missing car!

videos.title: Lost in the Jungle
videos.overview: Caillou learns all about the jungle at playschool, and decides it would be an exciting place for a game of hide and seek. The other children join in - Leo hides, and the others pretend to be birds, snakes, monkeys and even a lion.
